data.summary:
**When:** [Opponent's Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase), after an enemy unit finishes a [Normal move](vsdata:core-rule/normal-move), [advance move](vsdata:core-rule/advance-move) or [fall-back move](vsdata:core-rule/fall-back).

**Target:** A **HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY** or **HERETIC ASTARTES MOUNTED** unit of yours (not a **DAMNED** unit) up to 8" from that enemy unit, and outside [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) of every enemy unit.

**Effect:** The unit can carry out a [Normal move](vsdata:core-rule/normal-move) of at most 6".
